projects.name: Lovelace.Representation
projects.reason: Digit storage is consolidated into the base-10^9 limb Nat; representation invariants are held by lovelace-nat. Per-API coverage is not yet mapped test by test.

projects.name: Lovelace.Natural
projects.reason: Add/sub/mul/div_rem/pow/factorial, parse and format; 100! exact in tests.

projects.name: Lovelace.Integer
projects.reason: Sign plus Nat magnitude; no negative zero; truncating div_rem.

projects.name: Lovelace.Rational
projects.reason: No dedicated normalized-fraction type; rationals are exact Reals. REAL-009 (coprime normalized fractions) is an open gap.

projects.name: Lovelace.Real
projects.reason: Exact periodic decimals, sqrt, pi. Exactness provenance and clamp notices are not yet published on the wire, so REAL-001/REAL-004 are only partly met.

projects.name: Lovelace.Complex
projects.reason: Arbitrary-precision parts exist; the fixed-width optimized representations and the promotion contract (CPLX-003/004/005) are absent.

projects.name: Lovelace.Abstractions
projects.reason: No plugin contract, field abstraction, or kernel registration exists in the Rust workspace; the engine grows one enum of builtins instead.

projects.name: Lovelace.Statistics
projects.reason: The opt-in Real elementwise-addition kernel has no Rust equivalent (STAT-001..004 unmet).

projects.name: Lovelace.Suite
projects.reason: Language, engine, builtins, plotting exist; statement timing, revision semantics, and the structured envelope are incomplete (ENG-006/009, WIRE-002).

projects.name: Lovelace.Symbolics
projects.reason: Canonical expressions, calculus, solving, assumptions; the corpus gate is 212/214 (sym/071, sym/076 outstanding).

projects.name: Lovelace.MathIR
projects.reason: lower/compile/compile_full/evalir/evalir_batch exist as builtins; there is no separate versioned IR crate and MIR-001/MIR-007 are unverified.

projects.name: Lovelace.Dsp
projects.reason: fft, dft, conv, filter, conj, re, im are present; the remaining signal constructors and DSP-009/DSP-010 are unverified.

projects.name: Lovelace.Console
projects.reason: No interactive REPL crate exists (CLI-001..007 unmet).

projects.name: Lovelace.Run
projects.reason: A runner exists but is protocol-incompatible: 0/20 golden fixtures pass and 6 of the 14 CLI flags are unimplemented.

projects.name: Lovelace.Knowledge
projects.reason: No sampling, reduction, convergence, or behavioural-graph module exists (KNOW-001..010 unmet).

projects.name: Lovelace.Knowledge.Run
projects.reason: No MGIR command-line interface or JSON-over-stdio protocol exists.

projects.name: Lovelace.Studio
projects.reason: A Win32 native shell exists (no HTTP listener). Platform breadth, widget tests, screenshots and accessibility (DESK-001..028) are unmet; the Windows-only scope question is OQ-001.

projects.name: Lovelace.Proofs
projects.reason: The Lean project exists in the C# tree but no Rust theorem mapping or property correspondence has been established (PROOF-001..004 unmet).

formats.name: Knowledge graph JSON
formats.migration: Versioned, self-describing JSON whose complete field set is listed below and validated by parity/tools/format-check.mjs. The Rust workspace has no Knowledge module (projects.toml: absent, KNOW-001..010 unmet), so the C# oracle remains the only reader today. The version byte is checked by the validator; a Rust reader must reject any version other than 1 and is blocked on the Knowledge port, not on this format.

formats.name: Runner JSON envelope
formats.migration: No migration needed: the Rust runner emits the same versioned envelope. Verified by node parity/tools/gate-fixtures.mjs (20/20) and node parity/tools/gate-cli.mjs (16/16).

formats.name: MathIR text
formats.migration: No migration needed: both sides write and gate #!mathir 2. Verified by cargo test -p lovelace-lang mathir (deserialize and version-gate tests).

formats.name: Symbolic canonical text
formats.migration: No migration needed: the Rust runner publishes the same header. Verified by the golden fixtures and the CLI matrix.

formats.name: Plot SVG files
formats.readers: any SVG renderer; browsers; Rust desktop
formats.migration: No migration needed: the file is a standard SVG document with no proprietary wrapper. Verified by rendering a plot through the Rust binary and checking the SVG root (see the report for the run).

formats.name: Studio browser state
formats.migration: No file format and no server-side persistence: the values live in the browser origin and hold plain text plus panel dimensions. The Rust desktop keeps its own UI state. Editors can copy the text; nothing is lost that the product owns.

formats.name: Studio sessions
formats.migration: Sessions are process memory with an idle timeout; no serialized session file exists to migrate. Recorded so the absence is a decision, not an oversight.

formats.name: Knowledge.Run CLI JSON
formats.migration: Process protocol, not a stored file. It rides on the same Knowledge port as FMT-001 (CON-003/CON-006); until then the C# CLI remains the implementation and no Rust consumer claims otherwise.
